_doc: v4 plates (docs/V4-DESIGN.md). Each plate is one continuous scene (scenes/<file>.ts) that replaces every storyboard shot inside its window. Window = [from, to): anchors resolve exactly like shots.json anchors (lyric word -> beat grid snap + offset_beats). Shots partly inside a plate are clipped. Plates are added one by one; anything not covered still plays the v3 shots.
